tickets.title: Idempotency key lost on retried ledger write
tickets.description: A retried write to payments-ledger posted twice because the retry path dropped the idempotency key.

comments.author: mei
comments.text: Fixed: the key is now part of the retry envelope. Added a reconciliation check that flags duplicates within 24 hours.

tickets.title: Chargeback evidence upload fails for large files
tickets.description: Uploads over 20 MB time out in the chargeback evidence form. Support has to email documents instead.

tickets.title: Review fraud hold threshold
tickets.description: Proposal to lower the manual review score threshold after last quarter card-testing attempts. Details are restricted to payments and security.
